prompts.monitoring:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity Chinese desktop administration page design, flat straight-on full-screen UI screenshot, 1920x1080 or larger landscape 16:9, crisp readable Simplified Chinese.
Input images: Image 1 is ONLY a visual reference for the existing brand, top navigation, colors, and typography. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for the real light 2D road basemap around Jinan. Create a NEW page; do not reproduce their existing table content, gray backdrop or route corridor.
Shared application chrome: preserve the exact recognizable red 中国数联 / China Unidata logo at upper left from Image 1, the white full-width 84px header, centered TEXT-ONLY navigation reading 监管工作台、主体管理、准入与许可、运行监管、 安全监管、分析评价、AI智能体、管理设置. Select 运行监管 using light-blue pill and thin blue underline. Discrete dropdown chevrons, NO menu icons. Right user avatar and 济南市管理员. No left system-navigation sidebar, breadcrumb, browser chrome, device frame, perspective or presentation-board annotations.
Visual language: refined practical enterprise regulator software, existing Microsoft YaHei UI / clean Chinese sans-serif, 14-15px readable body and 18-20px section heading, dark navy #17324f text, #7d8fa8 secondary text, blue #3268f6 actions, #f5f7fb page background, white cards, fine #e5ebf4 borders, 8px corners, 4/8px grid, 24px page gutters, restrained shadows, generous but efficient spacing. No large top KPI cards, hero description, decorative charts or giant numbers.
Map treatment: a fully LOADED sharp 2D urban ROAD map, pale gray/off-white land, white main roads edged in quiet gray, legible road names and blocks, faint green parks, realistic road hierarchy. No satellite, 3D, dark cockpit theme, red mass overlay, haze, empty loading grid, heatmap or dense POIs. Operational areas are LARGE connected polygons covering multiple city blocks, never merely a narrow road corridor. Bright blue clear 3px boundaries, pale-blue fill about 5-8% so roads remain readable. Vehicle markers must be on visible actual road centerlines inside the allowed area, away from water/buildings/parks. Do not invent official map-provider logo or claim a legally precise cadastral map. Geography is a UI design reference.
Keep a small global blue AI助手 floating entry at lower right, clear of key controls. All sample names, counts, IDs and readings are illustrative design content, not claimed live telemetry; do NOT add 演示数据 labels to the UI. No remote steering, emergency stop, dispatch, order assignment or other vehicle-control buttons. Design exactly ONE complete page, no collage.
Primary request: design the municipal “运行监测” page, with the map as the central focal point and one selected vehicle's stable right-side detail panel open.
Layout: immediately below the global header, one separate wide query card across the page (about y108-200), with labeled fields 关键词 [搜索车辆名称或统一编码], 企业 [全部企业], 运行状态 [全部状态], 许可状态 [全部许可状态]; 查询 (blue-tinted) and 重置 buttons aligned far right. Below with 20px gap, a single full-height white monitoring workspace extending to bottom gutter. Workspace title 运行监测 at upper left; understated right actions 运行记录、更新于14:32:16、刷新. Do not add a second navigation tab bar.
Workspace below its title has three balanced columns: approx 290px vehicle rail at left, a generously dominant map around 1080px at center, and a 400-430px white “车辆详情” panel anchored on right with a close X and fine separating border. Detail is not a bottom panel and does not dim or cover the map.
Left rail: label 车辆列表 and compact local vehicle filter 全部65 / 异常3. Compact status filters 运行32、临停25、离线8; counts coherent. Show 7-8 clean vehicle rows: 济南配送车001 selected light blue, small ID SD37010000000001, 运行中 blue pill, 18 km/h; vehicle002 临停 green pill; vehicle003 运行中; vehicle004 离线 gray pill and 最后上报12分钟前; vehicle005 orange 异常 outline and 超速待核查; vehicle006 临停; vehicle007 运行中; vehicle008 离线. Compact enterprise secondary text. No full-row tinted color blocks. Scroll indication.
Map: realistic streets in 济南历城区 around 花园路、山大北路、历山路、二环东路. One large approved blue polygon labeled 历城城区运营区 covers many blocks and contains every shown marker. About 10-14 small car/directional markers spaced along visible roads, selected vehicle001 with blue halo and small white label 配送车001, movement and position visually coherent. Blue directional cars for 运行中, green compact car circles for 在线临停, gray outline car markers for 离线最后位置, one orange warning halo on an otherwise blue running marker; meaningful shapes in addition to colors. NO disconnected giant popover or enormous pulsing circles. At upper right a compact 图层 dropdown; right edge + / − and 定位 controls. At bottom left inside the map, a neat white legend with four labeled swatches: 运行中、在线临停、离线最后位置、异常关注. Another unobtrusive blue line sample label 许可通行范围. Bottom map scale 200m. No paths drawn through buildings.
Right vehicle panel: header 车辆详情 ×, prominent 济南配送车001, smaller SD37010000000001, blue 运行中 and green 在线 tags. Three local tabs 实时状态 selected / 历史轨迹 / 运行记录, all about the SAME selected vehicle. Two-column compact data: 当前速度18 km/h, 剩余电量86%, 驾驶模式自动驾驶, 今日里程42.6 km, 定位时间14:32:12, 数据时效4秒前. Then 许可与范围 section: 许可状态 有效, 许可类型 示范应用, 通行区域 历城城区运营区, 允许时段06:00–22:00, 许可限速20 km/h, green quiet inline result 当前位于许可范围内. Then 责任安全员 张伟 / 138****2618. A small 当前异常 section shows 暂无待核查异常 for THIS selected normal vehicle. At bottom two secondary buttons 查看档案 and 查看许可. No big stat tiles or decorative gauges. Align all text carefully.
